id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Thank you for coming. Erik... you look well too. It must be about five years since I last saw you.
"...Five years ago. Did I live in this town until then?
"Sniflheim's castle town was once a port of call for Vikings who sailed the northern sea. We traded and mingled a lot.
"...Erik. Back then, you were a henchman of those Vikings.
"Heliodor never discovered the thief Erik's origin no matter how we searched. To think he was born a Viking.
"As for birth, I can't say. Erik and his sister seem to have been taken in and raised by the Vikings as children.
"I don't know whether that was fortunate. He and his sister were forced into a harsh life.
"In fact, one day word came that his sister had died, and from that day he too vanished.
"As a priest, I regret that I couldn't save them. So if he is in trouble, now is the time...
"Forgive me, I didn't think of his feelings. Please look after Erik. I'll follow later."
